items.x: October settlement prices of Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) futures contracts are used to set harvest prices on Federal crop insurance products for corn and soybeans in the Midwest. Harvest prices are $4.75 per bushel

items.h: Democrats Surge to Power in Congress With Wins in Farm Country
items.x: "Farmers and ranchers spent the past year paying record prices for diesel and waiting on a farm bill that never came. Tuesday night, many of the states they farm in helped change who will write farm policy in Washington.
